$comment: The render context for templates/display-manager/regreet.toml.j2. Three names, all greeter appearance paths/strings. The template is retained for the greetd+regreet fallback path; no consumer renders it at v0.4.0, and that is why its contract is stated here rather than inferred from a role.
title: display-manager/regreet.toml.j2 — render context
description: The three values the regreet greeter config reads: background image path, font name, greeting message.

display_manager_greeter_background.description: Absolute path to a greeter-readable copy of a wallpaper ([background].path). Relative paths resolve against regreet's cwd, not the config dir.

display_manager_greeter_font.description: GTK font name for the greeter UI ([GTK].font_name). Must be installed for the greeter user.

display_manager_greeter_greeting.description: The login card's greeting text ([appearance].greeting_msg). May be empty: an empty greeting is a deliberate design choice, and the template renders it as an empty quoted string.

x-render-contract.no_default_on_required: No `default(` fallback: a fallback background path or font name is a greeter that renders with a wrong look and no error.
x-render-contract.unrendered_at_v040: Shipped as a contract, not a live render: the installer's SDDM-Pixie path is the default (spine AD-9) and the greetd+regreet templates are retained for the fallback. When that path is re-enabled the consumer supplies these three.
